decisions.rationale: The assignment-launch-result hashes form a closed forward-reference cycle, so no create-once artifact can be produced first. An acyclic pre-run assignment followed by real worker credit and post-run adapters is a localized schema sequencing fix and is necessary for any genuine substitute execution.
decisions.smallest_fix: Remove forward launch/result hashes and controller identity from the pre-run assignment; have the actual worker PASS check credit the immutable assignment hash; then create launch/execution/result adapters that reference the assignment and completed real invocation/status/result.

decisions.rationale: The final attribution, diagnostic adapter, and actual result similarly form a hash cycle. A pre-run diagnostic assignment carrying source/input/failure identities is the natural credit token; final diagnostic and attribution adapters can safely bind completed evidence afterward.
decisions.smallest_fix: Add one pre-run attempt-confined diagnostic assignment without future hashes, require the real diagnostic worker PASS check to credit its hash, then write diagnostic execution and final attribution adapters referencing the completed status/result and assignment.

decisions.rationale: Any status-shaped JSON under .agent-workspace currently supplies the controller identity. Binding the expected status path in the pre-run assignment and then verifying the post-run candidate invocation names exactly that output path is a small, non-cyclic equality check that completes real controller provenance.
decisions.smallest_fix: Record expected status/result paths in the pre-run assignment, bind a post-run hash reference to the actual candidate invocation, require invocation.output_paths.status and workspace RESULT location to match, then validate the exact status/result and derived controller identity.
